input.prompt: The reference images define the person and the photo style. Black-and-white studio instruction photo for a home-gym exercise manual, in exactly the style of the reference photos: the same man (short dark hair, clean-shaven, black sleeveless shirt, grey athletic shorts, white running shoes), plain light-grey seamless backdrop and light-grey floor, soft even studio lighting, slightly grainy monochrome print look, full body visible, nothing cropped, portrait format. No text, no watermark, no border, no logos, no mat. POSE: Knee-to-wall ankle mobilisation: standing barefoot in a split stance facing a plain light-grey wall, the front foot about 10 cm from the wall with the heel firmly flat on the floor, the front knee bent and pushed forward so that the kneecap clearly TOUCHES the wall, both hands flat on the wall at chest height, the back leg straight behind with the heel lifted. Camera at hip height from the side, athlete facing to the right of the frame, so the contact between knee and wall is clearly visible.
